verdict.detail: The album first came out in 1971 (UK).

notes.text:
"100% Official reissue of this Acid Folk/Psych legend. Limited Edition Coloured vinyl cut from original masters, includes insert."

Purple pressing in gatefold sleeve limited to 300 copies. 
Also available in 'green splatter' vinyl (300 copies).

Matte gatefold sleeve with original artwork.
Including a reproduction of the original insert.

Produced at Pye Studios Nov-Dec 1970

℗All tracks 1971 Licensed from Universal Music Operations Ltd
©This edition 2010 Rise Above Relics
All songs published by Our Music.


Timing on some tracks is inaccurate, the actual timing on 'The Herald' (12:22), 'Drip Drip' (11:09), 'Bitten' (2:18), taken from the first CD Japanese version
